key_points: UK gilt yields hit highest since 1998, dragging UK banks lower.
HSBC stock fell ~3.5-3.7% on budget‑tax fears despite a prior rally.
HSBC’s advice to buy BP and TotalEnergies shares is unrelated to its own fundamentals.

Minor corporate filings (voting rights, employee share plan) are routine and negligible.
